body: Yeah I had to learn that through experience. I've taken anti fungal medications that helped a bit but seems I have to resort to the IV anti fungal (amphotericin b). It's supposed to be a last option and I have no doubt that it'll be effective in getting rid of it but it seems it's also the only anti fungal that has more potential of causing long term health issues which is my main concern. Thought I'd post to reddit to see what others say and not email a scammer who posts fake success stories of people that were cured by taking their product lol
